name: claude-coach
description: Two opinionated coaching plugins for Claude Code: prompting-coach and english-coach

plugins.name: prompting-coach
plugins.description: Pre-flight prompt gate: when a request is severely under-specified, it opens a chooser with a concrete rewrite before work starts. No extra model call. Turn off with /prompting-coach:config off

plugins.name: english-coach
plugins.description: English coaching for Thai developers: every prompt becomes a mini English lesson delivered at the end of the same turn, evaluated in the background so it costs no waiting. Turn off with /english-coach:config off
